output: On both concrete [144] producer paths, Y consists of at most two selected terminal vertices, h is outside Y, and F is exactly the union of two trimmed first-entry arms, the two centre edges, and at most one core edge. Conditional on all four indexed non-centre incidences lying in F, cubicity forces both arms positive and forces a to be internal in P_b and b internal in P_a. Therefore the all-in-F survivor has crossed tails and an h-cycle of an unspecified non-target length. This is source-local mathematical evidence, not yet a published Holds fact or a productive move.
